content: Tawir 7 pela Kaem ko gomang magara ago

Se ani temple mu ningi kuring bo sail ago engel 7 pela mu nunga manarukaso se ikiem. Mu iwita balam, “Tawir 7 pela Kaem ko gomang magara ago anisan sumu gial ago namaral ale ali lilim la awote waralko!”

Se engel 1 mu ko tawir iluwaram mu ali lilim awote waram, ko memek mu lot aora memek memek mu kariimet mel diwang memek mu ko nup ko mak nungumik te taman, ale ko kuar nup patawu se anikasan mu nungumik te aratu aratu namakaso.
Se engel 2 mu ko tawir iluwaram mu gagi ningi waram, ko memek mu gagi kari kuera ale ko gue pakongara iwita pakonga namaram, se melmasak gagi ningi mu suen la kua sapaman.
Se engel 3 mu ko tawir iluwaram mu ali imi lilim awote yu bibiya se yu gotektek suen la nunga ningi waram, ko memek mu yu umu gue ko geragam.
Se ani ikiwerem mu yu bitaruwara ko engel umu mam:

content.text: “O Kakirip Laili nunguningkiri, ni girakala bagerem, ale aitak bagasam.
Ni nunga memek koma nungarsam mu ni
tutera munan diram la betesam, se awiri ko balukko?
Mu awuk, nuna nika kariimet laili alo se,
nika prophet alo nunga moman se kua gilingiman.
Se nunga memek umu ko koma te
tamonko mu te diram la iki se gue nungarem se no gilingiman.”

content: Asele ani altar te kuring bo aratam se ikiem, mu iwita balam:

content.text: Garagar, ni nunga betera kaora ko koma, te tamonko wore te diram la nungarsam.”

content: Se engel 4 mu ko tawir iluwaram mu worem awote waram, ko memek mu worem ko kore kowar mu kariimet nunga kanikaso.

Se worem ko kowar mu aora biya nunguningkiri se ninguru nunga kanikaso, se Kaem ikup yaman umu suen la gi sapawakaso mu ko balu maguwukasan. Bare nuna nongomang gurugumon ale nu nup biya tumonko ikia me tokasan.
Se engel 5 mu ko tawir iluwaram mu mel diwang memek umu ko daiga kuwim awote waram, ko memek mu ko kingdom lilim tiromorom biya iram. Se kariimet yaman biyala tokasan ale nia kika se,
nunga lot gawir se yaman umu ko, duruk wonong ko Kaem balu maguwukasan. Bare nuna nunga betera kaora memek suen la ko me ta giris palagakasan.
Se engel 6 mu ko tawir iluwaram mu yu biya Euphrates ningi waram, ko memek mu yu mu maraka namaram. Umutang te, koma worem bausa ko king alo te guyak la utu kapamonko lage kuring guyak awuram.
Asele ani bur memek ilagala suan, gorogoro iwita, mu nungarkem. Bo dragon kuring te aratam, se bo mel diwang memek mu kuring te aratam, se bo mu prophet kawel mu kuring te aratam.
Nuna wit mairap memek. Nuna ali lilim la ko king alo nongote namakasan ale miracle duap duap te, Kaem Sokel Garagar umu ko day tom biya umu te kager betemonko nunga ilu biguwukasan.

“Ikialko! Aninga taira mu tere kari ni me ko iki bataguruwara se taira iwita tairikko. Awiriya marak sinar ago baga se numi nunguru burangiwoso mu amilmilarukko. Uwuta mu asele tom biya mu kaparuk mu nu me tinga biririkirok, ale nunguning la bagoso mu ko me dolurukko.”
Se bur memek gorogoro iwita mu king alo suen la Hebrew nunga sor bo nup Armageddon
mu te nunga ilu biguwuman.
Se engel 7 mu ko tawir iluwaram mu kualala sor yam te waruwaram mu kuring bo temple ningi sail karogo balam, “Imitang nukum kitirawo!” mam. Kuring mu noko daiga kuwim te tairam.

Asele pure biliwilik makaso ale taga pagakaso ale nia nama taikaso, se wanara biya kapakaso. Wanara mu duap bo, wanara bo uwuta ali imi lilim te me kapakaso se kariimet katir me ko ikiman wore kapakaso.

Se wonong biya mu paga ilagala suanaram. Se sor sor suen la nunga wonong bibiya mu papak ma parasa kapakasan. Kaem wonong biya Babylon ko memek ko kuamili me saparam, nu ko gomang magara memek nunguningkiri mu waen bagun ningi langi tua se no kam, koma memek mu naukko langi tuam.
Tual gotektek suen la maga yumu namaman, se duruk suen la mu karogo la yumu namaman.

Se tuwik muguri bibiya, manga bibiya iwita, ko ikup 40 kilogram iwita, mu kariimet nungumik kuali kapakasan se memek ikup ninguru arigiman, ale ko Kaem balu maguwukasan. Mu awuk, Kaem ko gomang magara ko ikup umu am memek biya nunguningkiri.

footnotes.text: Lot memek aora aora: Exodus 9:10. Gagi gue iwita aratam: Exodus 7:17-21.
Nuna kariimet nunga moman se kueman ko koma: Isaiah 49:26; Revelation 17:6; 18:24.
Nuna me giris palagakasan: Revelation 9:20-21; 16:21. Tiromorom biya: Exodus 10:22.
Dragon, mel diwang memek, se prophet kawel: Revelation 13:11-15.
Kager biya: Revelation 19:19. Kari Biya tairate tairuk se biririkamonko: 1 Thessalonians 5:1-3.
Armageddon mu Israel sor te gomeng wosesel biya bo, duruk Megiddo duap te. Mu kager kuwim bo, kager suen biya te aratukaso.
Waen ko den: Psalm 75:8; Revelation 14:8-10. Tuwik muguri auram ale tai kapakasan: Exodus 9:24.
